criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: 3, 7 (28 chairs counted, the strongest image), 9 and 5 hold up at feed size. 6 cream boxes floating on black with the stake line nearly invisible; 2 a trapezoid on a noise plane with a flat black channel band; 4 a plain plank with a box for flagging; 8's mic stands rise behind the last dek lines; 1's sign front-lit and names no town.

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: One dark world, casts right, one accent meaning, the bookend and the room pair work, no value strobe. 5 to 6 reads as a cut because the stakes barely register; 3's concrete is a one-off material.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Every numeral traces and medium-confidence claims are attributed on the slide. The de-annexation rests on the Tribune, and slide 3's 109 times invites a reading the planned line about different kinds of money would have defused.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: What happened, who decides, what, where and when to act are all delivered. The protest's grounds (c22) are dropped and the abatement's size is not addressed.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: The cover earns the swipe, 2 pays, 4 turns. 7 calls to action, 8 steps back and 9 repeats 7's logistics.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: Plain lines work and the jobs side gets a fair hearing. 2's two sentences are clerical, 5 dates by the newspaper, 'Drawn to illustrate.' repeats.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: New concept against the last four decks. No. 61's nameless city limit sign, survey stakes on 62 and 69, and 62's abatement on behind-the-meter power are familiar within the window.

one_sentence_fix: Rebuild frame 6 so slide 5's stake line runs large in the foreground to a side-lit plant in its own pool with a pickup for scale, and give frame 2's square real ground.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: flat-lit cream boxes floating on black, the stake line nearly invisible
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: camera about 1.2 m with the three nearest flagged stakes large at lower left, the plant side-lit with a cast right, a pickup for scale

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: trapezoid on a noise plane, flat black channel, no relief or pool
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: crowned road with a lit shoulder, riprap bank in relief, saltgrass casting short shadows, pool on the near corner

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: the mics rise behind the last two dek lines
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: lower the camera or move the lectern so both mic heads sit below the dek, the rim on the mic head

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: front-lit, flat face, no town name
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: swing to the far side so the seam rims the sign with long casts right

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: plain extruded plank with a box for flagging, low-poly clods
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: pointed clay-dark foot, weathered grain, limp tied ribbon, crumbled crust at the lip
